_note: Hand-labeled eval set for T-2816 (decision-recall PoC). Authored BEFORE any retriever tuning against these scenarios or their expected labels — the discipline the brief asked for, so this set isn't fit to whatever the retriever happens to score well on. The one retriever change made before this file existed (adding 'about'/'without'/etc. to the stopword list) was driven by a SYNTHETIC unit-test fixture finding (tools/test_decision_recall_poc.py), not by these scenarios or the real ADR corpus. Positive scenarios are deliberately paraphrased away from the trigger-sidecar wording (tools/decision_recall_triggers.json), not copied from it, to avoid testing string-matching rather than retrieval. Negative scenarios split into 'easy' (no topical relation to any sidecar ADR) and 'hard' (topically adjacent to a sidecar ADR but should NOT fire it) to actually stress precision/false-trigger-rate, not just hit-rate. This is a rough first signal from one author's judgment calls, not ground truth — see decision_recall_poc_RESULTS.md for the caveat this carries into the numbers.
